title: Schartel releases electrifying new single "Alive" that'll drag you to the dancefloor
htmlContent:
Schartel is back with an exciting new single, "Alive," a dance-pop soundtrack filled with positive energy. This track is the most electronic piece on their upcoming 2025 album, "Colors," it seamlessly mixes retro sounds with modern vibes, showing Schartel's diversity.

The song starts with a catchy piano melody reminiscent of the '90s, immediately grabbing your attention. It quickly builds into a lively mix of sparkling synthesizers and real instruments, creating an electrifying sound. You can almost imagine yourself on a vibrant dance floor or at an exhilarating music festival.

https://open.spotify.com/album/1YQvUgIhnYmcdBotumIdWv?si=hceO7rMzTca_wrxaiQ_qxA

"Alive" carries a meaningful message, especially in uncertain times. Schartel offers a much needed dose of positiveness through uplifting melodies and rhythms, encouraging listeners to stay strong, enjoy the moment, and keep pushing forward. "Alive," is an energetic single that sets the tone for what looks to be an exciting journey in their album "Colors."
